capability.environment: Arena.ai agent sandbox: Node 22 renderer with @napi-rs/canvas and sharp, FFmpeg 9.0.2 and ffprobe for encoding and frame/audio inspection, image viewing tools for still-frame review

reviewer.method: Decoded the entire preview.mp4 at 2 fps into a 33-frame mosaic covering 0-16.4s and inspected it visually; inspected per-shot start/mid/end PNG evidence stills and the preview contact sheet; extracted and viewed baseline frames of approved-2026-10-23.mp4 at 1s, 6s, 12s and 18s; measured audio with ffmpeg volumedetect on both preview (mean -18.9 dB, max -1.3 dB) and baseline (mean -21.4 dB, max -1.7 dB); read preview.srt caption timings against project captions

observations.detail: Opening shot shows red YOUR CHANNEL / NOT YOUR FACE headline, YouTube play button, tilting hand-drawn camera and a panicked stick figure holding its head; caption 'Want a YouTube channel without being on camera?' is synced to the narration
Calendar with animated red strike appears beside the worried figure while the caption reads 'No weeks of animation.'; the strike line draws in over time rather than appearing at once
Idea bulb, curved arrow and growing yellow note illustrate 'a strong hook, a clear story'; the note visibly enlarges across consecutive sampled frames

Final shot: the small idea note slides into the YouTube player frame and the player pops slightly larger while the figure gestures; captions 'Here's how to turn one idea / into a video.' close the video; no black frames or caption overflow anywhere in the sampled timeline except the natural end

Baseline uses near-white paper background, large dark handwritten headline (WRITE.), small gray subline and hand-drawn desk scene with a slender stick figure; same paper tone and headline hierarchy as the preview's opening

Baseline JUST POST MORE? scene shows an exaggerated straining figure pushing a stack of video cards with sweat drops; preview's panicked and worried poses are simpler but share the same fine irregular black pen outline and expressive face language

Baseline EVERY NEW UPLOAD scene combines a slumped figure, a timeline slider with red dot and a NEW note; same limited warm yellow/red accent palette over ink lines used by the preview's bulb/note/calendar props

Baseline MORE POSTS != REMEMBERED uses red accent symbol, underline and fading dashed note; bottom-band sans captions in the baseline match the preview's Noto Sans caption treatment at the same band position
Slender stick figure with round head, raised brows and open mouth holds its head in panic; fine irregular pen outline on warm paper matches the baseline figure construction

limits: Hashes, decoded artifacts and complete coverage establish current-media provenance, not aesthetic equivalence.
Reviewer identity, independence, actual viewing/listening and capability limitations are declarations, not authenticated facts.
Independent agent review does not imply human approval or user acceptance.
Sample-target review compares the available approved examples, not identical plots, voices, pixels or unavailable originals.

B3 endpoint geometry and authored intentions are diagnostics. Each graphic and motion event still needs actual-MP4 independent review; wrong relationships and meaningless motion cannot receive a limited-capability waiver.
The complete approved Full V4 film is unavailable in this bundle; only sampled long-form compositions are comparable.
